Trade Room is a read-only, demo-first fantasy trade workbench for Apple Silicon
Macs running macOS 13 or newer. AI is disabled in the desktop app. Screenshot OCR
stays on this Mac. ESPN loading requires your separate explicit action.

This app is unsigned and not notarized. Follow MACOS.md for Apple's per-app
first-open process. Never disable Gatekeeper or remove quarantine.

Download the DMG and SHA256SUMS from this release together, verify the checksum,
quit Trade Room, mount the DMG and replace the app in Applications. Saved local
settings are separate from the app. No automatic download or installation exists.
SHA-256 detects corruption; it is not an independent publisher signature.
